# Provenance (verified 2026-10-06; comment lines are ignored by the script):
# - prefix_1e12.txt = the first 8,241 lines of the table; line 8,242 is
#   1000151515441 > 10^12. Every line's factors ascend and multiply to n.
# - n.raw = the first 131,856 B of the full-table n.raw (sha256 ae272474...);
#   dpaths.bin = the first 494,460 B of the full dpaths.bin (391ed7ca...);
#   fpaths.bin = the first 576,870 B of the full fpaths.bin (86828c5e...);
#   every value of d.raw occurs in the full-table d.raw (22b9b6ab...).
# - Every entry was identical in three runs before the freeze (the first 18
#   in a fourth as well). Confirmation runs after the freeze are listed in
#   selftest_runs.txt. Each paths_*.bin export re-encodes to its tree file
#   byte for byte and holds the encoder input's records as a multiset.
# - The exports depend on the tree shape only, not on the coding: c010 and
#   c011 export the same bytes, and so do c110 and c111.
# - The binaries that produced the published full-table files reproduce the
#   prefix files byte for byte: the PWT2 encoders of cells 010/110 and
#   011/111/d*, and the d* search (masks after 4 and 5 sweeps, and the paths).
# - Context set 3's tree-gap mantissa models are not used at this size (no
#   model beats the raw bits), so c011/c111/c111x exercise the set-2 classes
#   plus an empty sixth class. c001.cnd is 10.8 MB because its CND directory
#   holds one VByte for each of the 10,810,800 classes.
